# Socktainer

> Socktainer is a CLI/daemon for macOS (Apple Silicon) that exposes a Docker-compatible REST API on top of Apple's containerization framework (Apple container). It listens on the Unix socket `$HOME/.socktainer/container.sock` so existing Docker tooling (Docker CLI, Testcontainers, ...) can manage Apple containers.

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/socktainer/socktainer.github.io/main/docs/intro.md): what Socktainer is, features, installation and getting started
- [Docker Context](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/socktainer/socktainer.github.io/main/docs/docker-context.md): point the Docker CLI at Socktainer with a docker context
- [Registry Authentication](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/socktainer/socktainer.github.io/main/docs/registry-authentication.md): pull from private registries
- [Docker Engine API Feature Parity](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/socktainer/socktainer.github.io/main/docs/api-feature-parity.md): which Docker API endpoints are supported

## Tutorials

- [Testcontainers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/socktainer/socktainer.github.io/main/tutorial/testcontainers.md): run Testcontainers-based tests on macOS with Socktainer
